entries.161110da6b3e817d: Asian local subsidiaries of automobile manufacturers (OEMs)
entries.197fcc119a83410a: KASAI NORTH AMERICA, INC. is located in Murfreesboro, Tennessee, and manufactures automotive interior parts at a plant in the United States and sells them to Nissan North America, INC., Honda Development and Manufacturing of America, LLC, Subaru of Indiana Automotive, Inc., Toyota Motor Manufacturing, Indiana, Inc. and others.
entries.323dae45acd23c60: This reportable segment manufactures and sells automotive interior parts in China, Thailand, Indonesia, India and others.
entries.353998161a7646a5: This reportable segment manufactures and sells automotive interior parts in Japan.
entries.4e73958225a05e20: KASAI KOGYO CO., LTD. is an independent parts manufacturer that makes automotive interior parts such as door trim and roof trim in Japan, North America, Europe and Asia, and sells them to automakers.
entries.7f9301d814dad36d: KASAI MEXICANA S.A. DE C.V. manufactures automotive interior parts in León, Guanajuato State, and sells them to Nissan Mexicana,S.A. de C.V., Honda de Mexico S.A. de C.V., Mazda de Mexico Vehicle Operation S.A. de C.V. and others.
entries.926dc10a2f8c9a37: This reportable segment manufactures and sells automotive interior parts in China, Thailand, Indonesia, India and others. In China, Guangzhou Kasai Qiche Neishi Jian Youxian Gongsi and others supply Dongfeng Motor Co., Ltd., Nissan (China) Investment Co., Ltd. and others; in Thailand, KASAI TECK SEE CO.,LTD. and in Indonesia, PT KASAI TECK SEE INDONESIA supply local automobile manufacturers. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥21,251 million.
entries.b40fe14ec462552f: This reportable segment manufactures and sells automotive interior parts in the United States and Mexico. KASAI NORTH AMERICA, INC. in the United States and KASAI MEXICANA S.A. DE C.V. in Mexico supply products to local subsidiaries of NISSAN MOTOR CO., LTD. and HONDA MOTOR CO., LTD., among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥108,823 million, the largest of the four reportable segments.
entries.b85e85df7822688c: This reportable segment manufactures and sells automotive interior parts in Japan. The consolidated subsidiary Kasai Kōgyo Japan Co., Ltd. manufactures products using parts and other materials supplied by the company, and delivers most of them to customer OEMs through the company. Design and development of automotive interior parts is carried out by Kasai Tekuno Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥51,697 million.
entries.bcdd680ce926186f: This reportable segment manufactures and sells automotive interior parts in the United States and Mexico.
entries.c3815dcc66779fc7: This reportable segment manufactures and sells automotive interior parts in the United Kingdom.
entries.c3a17c99ec9ebe57: European local subsidiaries of automobile manufacturers (OEMs)
entries.cc8d0f4269903439: North American local subsidiaries of automobile manufacturers (OEMs)
entries.e8033f964df9c0f1: This reportable segment manufactures and sells automotive interior parts in the United Kingdom. KASAI UK LTD manufactures and sells products to Nissan Motor Manufacturing (UK) Ltd. and JAGUAR LAND ROVER AUTOMOTIVE PLC. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥14,417 million.
